exact_question: Under the pinned hillipop-ede_n3 source/configuration, the same fixed admitted common background and matched validated z=810 start state used by Q051, does the actual native CLASS/P6 low-z implementation produce q=xHeII=10^-6 versus q=0 electron-fraction and Thomson-optical-depth histories that are reproducible, trajectory-consistent with the literal source-real dynamics, and contained within Q051's uniform analytic bounds; and what are the realized sup|Delta x_e| and sup|Delta tau_T| with a validated numerical error certificate?

method.coordinates: Use t=(a-a_left)/a_left for a single cell, retaining exact rational a. y=(phi,X). In u=ln(a), y'=(X/H,-3X-U_phi/H), with H²=B0+(X²/2+U+f)/3. Divide the field by 1+t for t.
method.center: Start a degree-12 reference polynomial P at the exact midpoint of the two stored intervals. Coefficients are exact representations of selected numerical values. A polynomial is a reference curve, and every truncation and rounding error enters the validated defect.
method.tube_and_defect: Certify a convex state box B containing the true trajectory by whole-cell Picard inclusion and containing P([0,h]). Certify H²>0 and the literal EDE guard over the whole cell. Use outward Taylor algebra with rigorous remainder to bound each component of F(t,P(t))-P'(t), preserving cancellation in the polynomial coefficients. Bound the absolute defect by r_i.
method.comparison: On [0,h]×B bound J=∂_yF. Take constant M_ii≥sup J_ii, M_ij≥sup|J_ij| (i≠j), with exact/outward bounds. Do not replace a proven negative diagonal by its absolute value. From the initial componentwise radii, enclose w'=Mw+r and use |y-P|≤w. Use a positive shift of the augmented Metzler matrix and a certified exponential series/tail with directed rounding, or an equivalent separately justified enclosure of the same comparison. Intersect the endpoint box with B only after proving both inclusions. An empty intersection is a defect.
method.acceptance_and_controller: First proposal is the last V101 relative step. Then use the last accepted relative step; halve on rejection, grow by 3/2 after two consecutive no-retry accepts with defect <= one quarter of budget, cap relative step at 1/16. Round interior right endpoints down to the 2^-120 grid, clip at exact waypoint and target, and reject a nonadvancing grid step. Use a declared per-unit-t absolute defect budget 1e-8 in phi and 1e-8 Mpc^-1 in X, measured on the entire cell. This replaces the 1e-22 Taylor-tail heuristic. Record defects, comparisons, retry reasons, runtime and widths.

decision_gates.waypoint: Operational feasibility requires reaching exactly 2*a_start within 300 seconds with energy interval width at most 10 times the V101 endpoint width. Stop and retain the last valid enclosure if reached but too wide. This threshold assesses early transport and does not establish a pilot anchor.
decision_gates.anchor: Exact a=1/801, certified source linkage, contiguous cells and validated finite endpoint energy. Record attained interval width and upper bound.
decision_gates.screen: Only at a certified z800 anchor, use de/dln(a)=-3X² and intersect the new upper cap with the old per-cell caps across [750,800]. Reuse the identical 105 subcells. Recompute and independently check the one weight screen against the frozen width ceiling. The stated sufficient energy cap is a conservative design diagnostic, not a necessary condition for running the screen. Record a certified anchor separately from the weight decision.

verification: Verify exact chain and interval inclusion, recompute defect and comparison bounds at increased precision for the accepted cells within the budget, and independently check the first/last cell field, guard and comparison inequalities using a separate interval evaluation. Mark only the verified prefix as eligible. Record shared code and independently checked scope.
stop_condition: Stop at the target and one eligible weight evaluation, first unresolved premise/invalid comparison/empty intersection, waypoint tightness failure, retry cap, or 300 seconds for propagation and its new-cell checks. Keep the last verified exact checkpoint; report the first failing condition and no extrapolated completion time.
